# Štefan Šraga — Photography, Video & Creative Marketing

> Photo and video creator and marketing strategist from Most, Czech Republic. Esports, sports and event coverage plus brand campaigns since 2015.

Štefan Šraga (Stefan Sraga) is a photographer and creative marketer based in Most, Czech Republic, active since 2015. He covers esports events (Intel Extreme Masters, ESL One, Gamescom, E3, League of Legends Worlds), football (long-term partnership with FK Teplice), ice hockey, cars and rally, urbex and Comic-Con Prague. He also runs the trading-card project Šragi-Cards (https://www.sragicards.cz/).

## Services

- Photography — event, sports and esports photography; details that preserve emotion and atmosphere.
- Video — cinematic videos for events, brands and campaigns; an IEM aftermovie passed 100,000 views.
- Marketing — strategy, SEO and analytics setup, PPC, e-mail campaigns, branding, websites and e-shops built to convert.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.stefansraga.com/): Photo and video creator and marketing strategist from Most, Czech Republic. Esports, sports and event coverage plus brand campaigns since 2015.
- [Photos](https://www.stefansraga.com/photos/): Eight photo galleries in one place: esports majors, football, ice hockey, live events, cars, Rally Prague Revival, urbex and Comic-Con Prague.
- [Videos](https://www.stefansraga.com/videos/): Video portfolio of esports aftermovies, event films and commercial promo spots — including an Intel Extreme Masters video with over 100,000 views.
- [Marketing](https://www.stefansraga.com/marketing/): Digital marketing from idea to launch: SEO and analytics setup, PPC campaigns, data analysis, email marketing, branding and websites built to convert.
- [About](https://www.stefansraga.com/about-me/): The story of Štefan Šraga: from game retail in 2015 to E3 accreditation, founding Nessus Gaming, partnering with FK Teplice and going self-employed.
- [Blog](https://www.stefansraga.com/blogs/): Reports from IEM Katowice, Gamescom, LoL Worlds and E3, plus Apple gear reviews — all written from behind the camera, with some posts in Czech.

## Photo galleries

- [Events](https://www.stefansraga.com/events/): Event photo gallery from E3 in Los Angeles, Gamescom in Cologne, ESL tournaments and LoL Worlds — crowds, stages and atmosphere from the front row.
- [Cars](https://www.stefansraga.com/cars/): Automotive photo gallery where design meets engineering: light tracing curves and bodywork, motion blur and speed paused in a single sharp frame.
- [Urbex](https://www.stefansraga.com/urbex/): Urbex photo gallery of abandoned places frozen in time: peeling paint, shattered glass and empty halls slowly being reclaimed by nature and silence.
- [Football](https://www.stefansraga.com/football/): Matchday photography from the pitch: FK Teplice in action, tackles, saves and celebrations — the emotion and rhythm of football, frame by frame.
- [Ice Hockey](https://www.stefansraga.com/icehockey/): Ice hockey photo gallery built on speed, precision and heart — carving skates, flying pucks and the split seconds that decide games under arena lights.
- [Comic-Con Prague](https://www.stefansraga.com/comicconprague/): Photo report from Comic-Con Prague 2024: cosplayers from Ghost to Jack Sparrow and the best moments of the Czech celebration of games and movies.
- [Rally Prague Revival](https://www.stefansraga.com/rallypraguerevival/): Photo report from Rallye Prague Revival: classic rally cars with real character, fuel fumes, dust, puddles and mud — motorsport history back on stage.

- [Apple Studio Display Product Review](https://www.stefansraga.com/post/apple-studio-display-recenze-produktu/) (2025-10-31): Six months with the Apple Studio Display: Delta E under 1, the VESA mount option, gaming limits and who should rather save money on a regular monitor.
- [HC Sparta Praha vs HC Dynamo Pardubice 02 arena - Praha](https://www.stefansraga.com/post/hc-sparta-praha-vs-hc-dynamo-pardubice-02-arena-praha/) (2025-10-15): Ice hockey photography from behind the plexiglass: accredited at the O2 Arena for HC Sparta Praha vs Dynamo Pardubice, a goal-filled game and a shootout.
- [Why Apple? Products That Influence My Work Every Day](https://www.stefansraga.com/post/pro%C4%8D-zrovna-apple-produkty-kter%C3%A9-mou-pr%C3%A1ci-ovliv%C5%88uj%C3%AD-ka%C5%BEd%C3%BD-den/) (2025-10-06): Why a photographer and marketer works only on Apple: MacBook Pro rendering speed, one ecosystem across iPad, Watch and AirPods, and where it falls short.
